data.bottom_line: Most slopes are generally safe from avalanches due to shallow or discontinuous snow cover. You might be able to trigger a small avalanche where recent winds have formed pockets of stiffened snow below ridgelines, on lee slopes, and around rocky outcrops in the alpine.

Most slopes are safe from avalanches due to thin and discontinuous snow cover. You might be able to trigger a small avalanche where recent winds have formed isolated pockets of stiff snow below ridgelines, on lee slopes, and around rocky outcrops in the alpine.
